scope: Two prioritized educational modules; focused reuse review

works.title: ViewSpace / NASA: Eagle Nebula
works.decision_relevance: Link as optional enrichment; Hebrew interface and requested controls are absent.
supported_claims: Interactive observations at different wavelengths, not a cloud mass/density collapse model.
works.limitations: Link as optional enrichment; Hebrew interface and requested controls are absent.

works.title: MySimulator: Jeans Instability
works.decision_relevance: Direct conceptual match; full page retrieval failed twice, license and equations could not be verified. Do not copy.
supported_claims: Author advertises mass, radius, temperature, Jeans threshold and free-fall time.
works.limitations: Direct conceptual match; full page retrieval failed twice, license and equations could not be verified. Do not copy.

works.title: David Greenheck: WebGPU Black Hole
works.decision_relevance: MIT code available, but renderer is for appearance/lensing, not stellar collapse. Link as optional exploration; retain for future lensing module.
supported_claims: README, shader source and LICENSE inspected: renderer uses physically-inspired raymarching and disk shading.
works.compute: WebGPU/Three.js; device performance not independently measured
works.limitations: MIT code available, but renderer is for appearance/lensing, not stellar collapse. Link as optional exploration; retain for future lensing module.

works.title: Illinois: Stellar Structure and Evolution
works.decision_relevance: Useful future stellar evolution/H–R reference; no mass-density cloud controls. Runtime and reuse license not verified.
supported_claims: Form accepts stellar mass and metallicity and evolves existing stars.
works.limitations: Useful future stellar evolution/H–R reference; no mass-density cloud controls. Runtime and reuse license not verified.

works.title: OpenStax Astronomy 2e 21.1
works.decision_relevance: Basis for stages and explanatory copy; no imported artwork/code.
supported_claims: Cold dense cloud cores can collapse; a protostar precedes sustained hydrogen fusion.
works.licenses: CC BY 4.0 as identified by book footer
works.limitations: Basis for stages and explanatory copy; no imported artwork/code.

works.title: OpenStax Astronomy 2e 21.2
works.decision_relevance: Stage animation must not be presented as a measured timeline or exact core temperature.
supported_claims: Gravitational contraction releases energy; later heat retention warms the protostar; contraction times depend on mass.
works.licenses: CC BY 4.0 as identified by book footer
works.limitations: Stage animation must not be presented as a measured timeline or exact core temperature.

works.title: OpenStax Astronomy 2e 24.5
works.decision_relevance: Mass-radius thought experiment. Do not imply Sun naturally forms black hole or draw a visible stellar interior after horizon formation.
supported_claims: Nonrotating horizon radius is 2GM/c², approximately 3 km per solar mass.
works.licenses: CC BY 4.0 as identified by book footer
works.limitations: Mass-radius thought experiment. Do not imply Sun naturally forms black hole or draw a visible stellar interior after horizon formation.

works.title: C. Dominik: Molecular clouds lecture notes, section 2.2
works.decision_relevance: Compute initial stability and a characteristic free-fall time, not the full duration to fusion.
supported_claims: Isothermal Jeans mass and pressureless uniform-density free-fall time; magnetic/turbulent support neglected.
works.limitations: Compute initial stability and a characteristic free-fall time, not the full duration to fusion.

works.title: NASA: Anatomy of a black hole
works.decision_relevance: Show a schematic horizon boundary, not a claim to reproduce a telescope image.
supported_claims: Event horizon, accretion disk and apparent shadow are distinct concepts.
works.licenses: Use original copy and links only
works.limitations: Show a schematic horizon boundary, not a claim to reproduce a telescope image.
